2610.13116.title: DRYLAB-Bench: Benchmarking the Biosecurity Risk of Agentic LLM Mutation Design
2610.13116.paper_summary: As large language models (LLMs) acquire advanced biological design capabilities, they offer substantial research benefits but simultaneously introduce severe dual-use risks, such as engineering enhanced pathogens or drug-resistant bacteria. While biosecurity frameworks recognize these threats, the actual risk of LLMs executing dangerous biological modifications remains unquantified, particularly when augmented with specialized biological design tools (BDTs). Existing evaluations primarily assess hazardous knowledge possession rather than practical application, overlook risk amplification from BDTs, and rely on unreliable, expensive, or hazardous validation methods. To address these gaps, we introduce DRYLAB-Bench (Design Risk Yielded by LLM Agent in Biodesign), the first comprehensive benchmark evaluating the high-risk biological mutation design capabilities of LLM agents. Moving beyond basic question-answering, DRYLAB-Bench tasks agents with 30 genuinely hazardous mutation-design scenarios distilled from biosecurity guidelines. It evaluates models in a multi-round, tool-augmented environment where LLMs orchestrate BDTs to iteratively refine candidates. Crucially, it scores designs directly against 187,695 empirical wet-lab measurements from ProteinGym and ViroGym using our proposed Biosecurity Risk Score (BRS), quantifying risk-associated effects while enabling scalable and safe ground-truth verification. Evaluations of 15 frontier models reveal substantial baseline threats: without tools, 67.6% of one-shot designs exceed the average measured variant, and 21.4% reach the highest-risk decile. Equipping models with BDTs significantly amplifies this risk, raising the pooled risk by \(ΔBRS=+0.116\) and the top-decile share to 23.5%. Code: https://github.com/drylab-bio/DRYLAB-Bench
2610.13116.paper_summary_zh: 隨著大型語言模型（LLMs）獲得先進的生物設計能力，它們提供了可觀的研究利益，但同時也引入了嚴重的雙重用途風險，例如工程增強病原體或耐藥性細菌。雖然生物安全框架承認這些威脅，但LLMs執行危險生物修改的實際風險仍未量化，特別是在與專業生物設計工具（BDTs）結合使用時。現有的評估主要評估危險知識的擁有，而非實際應用，忽視了BDTs帶來的風險擴大，並依賴不可靠、昂貴或危險的驗證方法。為了解決這些缺口，我們推出了DRYLAB-Bench（由LLM代理在生物設計中產生的設計風險），這是第一個綜合基準，評估LLM代理的高風險生物突變設計能力。DRYLAB-Bench超越了基本的問答，為代理提供了30個真正危險的突變設計場景，這些場景提煉自生物安全指導方針。它在一個多輪、工具增強的環境中評估模型，LLMs協調BDTs以迭代地完善候選者。關鍵是，它根據來自ProteinGym和ViroGym的187,695個實證濕實驗測量直接對設計進行評分，使用我們提出的生物安全風險分數（BRS），量化風險相關的影響，同時實現可擴展和安全的真實驗證。對15個前沿模型的評估顯示出可觀的基線威脅：在沒有工具的情況下，67.6%的單次設計超過了平均測量變異，21.4%達到了最高風險的十分位。為模型配備BDTs顯著擴大了這一風險，將整體風險提高了 \(ΔBRS=+0.116\)，並使最高十分位的比例上升至23.5%。代碼：https://github.com/drylab-bio/DRYLAB-Bench
